title: The ARM Scalable Vector Extension
key_contribution: Introduced the SVE ISA design with Vector-Length Agnostic programming model, predication, and first-faulting loads for safe speculative access.

title: A sneak peek into SVE and VLA programming
key_contribution: Practical guide to SVE intrinsics and VLA programming patterns, including loop control with whilelt and predicated operations.

title: Engineering the Scalable Vector Extension in .NET
key_contribution: Documented integration of SVE support into .NET runtime, demonstrating practical VLA programming for high-level language runtimes.

title: Implementing strlen using SVE
key_contribution: Demonstrated SVE string processing patterns (strlen) with VLA loops, directly applicable to Base64 stream processing.
